description_en: Diagnoses IPsec-VPN connections by calling the DiagnoseVpnConnections operation
kebab_example: aliyun vpc diagnose-vpn-connections --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp10hz6b0mbp39flt0000 --vpn-connection-ids vco-bp1spxu8hlcvpd7ry0000 --tunnel-ids tun-64n1sr9dig64k60000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DiagnoseVpnConnections

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The list of IPsec-VPN connection IDs
parameters.name: vpn_connection_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list

VpnConnections.description_en: The diagnostic information list of IPsec-VPN connections

items.description_en: The diagnostic information of an IPsec-VPN connection

FailedTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the current error occurred on the IPsec-VPN connection. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in UNIX format and represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to the time when the current error occurred on the IPsec-VPN connection
FailedTime.description_zh:
IPsec-VPN连接发生当前错误的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至IPsec-VPN连接发生当前错误时的总时长

MismatchLocalParam.description_en: The parameter value configured on the IPsec-VPN connection when the parameter values configured on the IPsec-VPN connection and the peer gateway device do not match
MismatchLocalParam.description_zh: 在IPsec连接和对端网关设备配置的参数值不匹配的情况下，本参数表示IPsec连接配置的参数值

MismatchRemoteParam.description_en: The parameter value configured on the peer gateway device when the parameter values configured on the IPsec-VPN connection and the peer gateway device do not match
MismatchRemoteParam.description_zh: 在IPsec连接和对端网关设备配置的参数值不匹配的情况下，本参数表示对端网关设备配置的参数值

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the current error.

Critical: Critical. Troubleshoot the issue immediately.
Warn: Warning. Troubleshoot the issue as soon as possible.
Normal: Normal
Severity.description_zh:
当前错误等级。

Critical：严重，请尽快排查处理。
Warn：警告，建议尽快排查处理。
Normal：正常

SourceLog.description_en: The log information related to the current error
SourceLog.description_zh: 当前错误相关的日志信息
SourceLog.example: 2023-01-13 11:39:21 vco-bp1spxu8hlcvpd7ry**** [PROTO_ERR]: ikev1.c:1433:isakmp_ph1resend(): phase1 negotiation failed due to time up. [{remote id:4}{ph1: 172.16.0.88[500] <=> 192.168.0.206[500], 172.16.0.88 <=> 192.168.0.206}]

VpnConnectionId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
